apps.name: Collections

apps.name: Listening Insights
apps.description: Beautiful Spotify listening dashboard with heatmaps, streaks, goals, recaps, genre charts, playlist export, and advanced taste insights.

apps.name: AutoQueuer
apps.description: Automatically queue a specific song after another using custom Spotify queue rules.
